caption: The drawing consists of a decorative blue floral motif, painted in shades of blue and violet, with a stem curving to the left. The flower features round and elongated petal shapes and small circular buds, all rendered with watercolor shading. Above the flower, there is a shaded rectangular area containing the text "SATTERRLEE & MORY FORT EDWARD NY" and the number "2," both written in capital letters with the number larger and underlined. In the lower right portion of the drawing, there is a simple line drawing of a crock or jar, outlined in blue, with the same flower motif and the same text and number depicted on its side. The entire composition is bordered by a thin blue rectangular outline. In the lower left corner, the name "GEO. LOUGHRIDGE." appears in small, capital letters. The background color throughout is an off-white or beige tone, with the main areas of artistic color being shades of blue in the floral design and the jar outline.
title: Crock
